name: @layoutit/polycss-domformat
description: Private deterministic retained-DOM JSON format for PolyCSS prepared models.

scripts.check: node --check bin/domformat.js && node --check src/*.js && node --check src/state/*.js && node --check conformance/viewer/*.js && node --check scripts/*.js && node --check viewer/*.js
scripts.conformance: python3 -B conformance/run_corpus.py && python3 -B conformance/check_canonical.py && python3 -B conformance/check_css.py
scripts.test:release: npm run check:nversion && npm test && npm run conformance && npm run test:browser && npm run pack:check
